motion.page_transitions: Subtle opacity and slight y-axis slide (initial: { opacity: 0, y: 6 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, transition: { duration: 0.25, ease: 'easeOut' })

motion.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with respect to prefers-reduced-motion media query

accessibility.wcag_compliance: WCAG 2.1 AA with strict minimum 4.5:1 text contrast for body and 3:1 for large graphical titles
accessibility.test_attributes: Every interactive button, table row action, modal trigger, tab, and input MUST have a dedicated `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='lang-toggle-hi', data-testid='work-order-row-PO-2026-001', data-testid='download-bill-pdf-btn')
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full focus-visible ring styles (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-blue-600 focus-visible:outline-none)

pdf_and_export_strategy.approach: Professional client-side branded PDF generator for Invoices and Work Orders using modern printable CSS templates or dynamic HTML2Canvas / jspdf / native browser printable iframe format, complete with Company Header, GSTIN, HSN/SAC codes, Tax breakdown (CGST/SGST/IGST), Authorized Signatures, and Bank details
pdf_and_export_strategy.print_styling: Provide dedicated @media print CSS rules for clean borderless high-resolution A4 tax invoice printouts

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete B2B Enterprise Cloud Vendor Portal with seamless switching between Vendor Portal and Admin Command Center.
Support dual language (English & Hindi) across all pages, navigation, tables, tooltips, and status tags using a clean context/state dictionary.
Implement demo instant-login buttons for 'Vendor: Premier Industrial Supplies' and 'Admin: Enterprise Procurement Officer' so anyone can test both workflows with 1 click.

Vendor workflow: View assigned Work Orders, Milestone tracking, Submit & View Invoices, Check Live Payment Status (Paid, In Review, Scheduled, Rejected), Download PDF Tax Invoices & Purchase Orders, Manage Vendor Profile & Upload Compliance docs (GST, MSME, Bank Cancelled Cheque).

Admin workflow: Manage Vendors list, Issue new Work Orders (with itemized deliverables), Review submitted Bills, Approve/Reject payments with remarks, Update payment transaction IDs (UTR number) and payout dates.
Include rich pre-seeded mock Indian enterprise data: INR (₹) currency formatting, realistic GSTIN numbers, HSN/SAC codes, milestone timelines, and mock downloadable PDF invoices.
Ensure 100% responsiveness on mobile, tablet, and wide desktop screens, with custom styled data tables, search filters, status filter tabs, and rich toast alerts via Sonner.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements as strictly mandated.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.design_purity: Avoid generic AI slop. Use authoritative industrial typography (Outfit + Plus Jakarta Sans), high contrast deep navy sidebars, clean crisp white cards with 1px border-slate-200, and vivid status indicators.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `opacity`, `transform`, `background-color`.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Never use transparent backgrounds on modals, dropdowns, sticky headers, or sidebars. Always specify crisp backdrop blur or solid white / dark slate backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use `sonner` via `@/components/ui/sonner.jsx` for all notifications (invoice submission, status changes, PDF generation, profile updates).
